new.statement: Developer-product prices split the charts: higher median prices go with dominance and revenue efficiency but with lower breakout positions, so successful games likely raise prices as they age rather than launch expensive
new.rationale: Today products_median_price is +0.28 on Most Popular and +0.38 on Top Earning but -0.26 on Top Trending and -0.22 on Up-and-Coming. Game age is the main confounder. Confirm by tracking price changes within the same games over weeks once page history allows; refute if young games that launch above 136 R$ reach Top Earning no faster.

new.statement: Folk-horror games built on a regional ghost story (Indonesian MALAM SAMA OPAH, Arabic الشايب) climb the breakout charts and reach Most Popular with audiences that global horror games don't target
new.rationale: MALAM SAMA OPAH (17 days) is #4 on Up-and-Coming and the top Most Popular riser (+18); الشايب (21 days) is the second-best Top Trending climber (+33). Confirm if more regional-ghost games enter and hold the top half of Up-and-Coming; refute if they fall off within three weeks like the retired H-x-014 cases.

qualitative_updates.note: More Halloween-tagged games lost ground without a follow-up: Pokemon Brick Bronze (Halloween), [🎃] Saber Simulator and HUNTRESS left Top Earning, +1 Upgrade Per Kill [🎃] left Top Trending, and Candy Kingdom Defense [🎃] (updated 11 days ago) fell 34 places on Top Earning; [🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox, updated today, rose 79 there instead.

The ragdoll wave keeps renewing: Ragdoll Wars!, WRECKED and Ragdoll Research (9 days) entered Up-and-Coming, Ragdoll Physics rose 73 there and entered Top Trending, and Realistic Ragdoll Playground entered Most Popular at 20 days; older entrants (Ragdoll Physics 2, Destruction Engine Testing) left Most Popular, so individual games churn quickly.

DONT SPLASH holds #3 on Up-and-Coming and the top of Most Popular, and a '+1 DONT SPLASH' spin-off entered Up-and-Coming, but DONT SWIM (12 days) is among the weakest on Top Trending, so derivatives may not carry the wave.
The Hollow, the Roblox-run event game, fell 54 places on Most Popular at 24 days with no passes or products, suggesting the lift ends with the event window.
